newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg up on Q2 earnings outlook - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg up on Q2 earnings outlook - analyst.

text.p: Shares of Kellogg Co were up 2-1/2 at 91-1/2 on expectations in the market that the cereal company likely will report stronger than estimated second-quarter earnings, an analyst said.

"It reflects the general belief that the quarter that Kellogg is about to report signals the end of the earnings weakness that the company has endured for the last few years," Schroder & Co analyst David Rabinowitz said.

The current consensus for the second quarter is $0.73 a share, up from depressed year-ago earnings of $0.45. Analysts, however, have said that Kellogg could beat that consensus and report earnings approaching the $0.77 a share it earned in the 1995 second quarter.
Kellogg's earnings in 1996 suffered from a cereal industry price cut.
Rabinowitz said that, despite some of Wall Street's optimism regarding Kellogg, he remains concerned that the U.S. ready-to-eat cereal category is growing slowly.
